descriptionChirho: To wash or launder garments, clothing, or the body, as the primary intensive active sense of כבס in the Piel stem across all finite verb inflections.
A professional washer or fuller of cloth, used as a substantive participle to denote the occupation of laundering garments.
The reflexive or middle sense of washing, indicating that something undergoes the process of being washed, in the Hitpael stem.
The intensive passive sense indicating that something is washed or shall be washed, in the Pual stem.
